description: This Java source file defines the 'CommandResponse' interface which represents various responses related to commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes method signatures, default method implementations, and nested classes for JSON field definitions. The interface is annotated for indexing subclasses and extends a 'Signal' interface, indicating its role in the signaling system of the project.

classes.name: CommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains common JSON field definitions for command response objects, including type, status, and payload fields.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the response.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version that the response implements, defaulting to the latest if not specified.

methods.name: isOfExpectedResponseType
methods.description: Checks if the response is of an expected response type based on headers.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the type of this response, defaulting to RESPONSE.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP-like status code of the command response.

methods.name: getStatusCodeValue
methods.description: Provides the integer value of the status code.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the response to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the response to JSON with specified schema version and predicate filtering.
